War chest: FactionWar is the referrer on every attack (self-referral \u2014 confirmed on-chain against Base Sepolia that Jackpot allows referrer == msg.sender). Faction members can also top the chest up directly via `depositToWarChest`. attack(uint8[],uint8).notice: Buy one real Megapot ticket on the caller's behalf, tagged to their faction. Price is discounted based on the faction's territory share, subsidized from that faction's own war chest (see `_quoteDiscount`) — the caller still pays the rest.

depositToWarChest(uint256).notice: Top up the caller's own faction's war chest directly, no territory or referral fees required. Restricted to faction members — you can only fund your own team. Deposited USDC funds the same territory-tier attack() discount as swept referral fees; it's never withdrawn.

getAttackQuote(address).notice: Preview what `attack()` would cost `player` right now — for the frontend to show the discount before they commit to a transaction.

getFactionScores().notice: Leaderboard data: territory count, Herald bonuses, and war chest balance (USDC, 6 decimals) — the chest subsidizes attack() discounts, it is never withdrawn — all indexed by Faction enum value.

getMapState().notice: Full map for the frontend to poll. Reads `ballMax` live from the current drawing.

getZone(uint8).notice: Single zone's controller + live (unresolved) per-faction ticket counts. `liveCounts` is indexed by Faction enum value (0=NONE unused, 1=RED, 2=BLUE, 3=GREEN).

joinFaction().notice: One-time, permanent faction assignment for the caller — no manual pick, no re-picking. Assigns to whichever faction currently has the fewest players so factions stay roughly balanced instead of everyone piling onto one team.

resolveDrawing(uint256).notice: Resolve a settled drawing into zone captures. Callable by anyone, once.

triggerBattle().notice: Race to trigger nightly settlement; caller's faction becomes the Herald for this drawing.
